content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway allows digital creators to accept payments without the need for Know Your Customer (KYC) checks. This means that sellers can process transactions without lengthy verification processes or the risk of having their accounts frozen. In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, where traditional payment platforms may not operate effectively, this architecture becomes crucial. By leveraging cryptocurrency as a payment method, creators can bypass the limitations imposed by conventional payment gateways, significantly increasing their sales opportunities and keeping more of their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture of a no-KYC payment system typically involves several components that work seamlessly together. At the core, platforms like NOWPayments handle the crypto transaction processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain without requiring personal information, ensuring privacy. The product delivery is automated through solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which manage the order fulfillment process efficiently. This combination eliminates the dependency on traditional financial institutions and empowers creators to manage their sales independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

No-KYC payment gateways are designed specifically for digital creators who sell products like ebooks, courses, and software. This includes individuals in countries where platforms like Gumroad impose hefty fees, such as 10% per sale, which can drastically cut into profits. For example, with 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee difference between a traditional platform and NOWPayments can retain $921 for the creator. By using a no-KYC gateway, creators can increase their earnings and expand their reach across borders, ultimately fostering a more inclusive digital economy.
Retain more profits with lower transaction fees using NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture of a no-KYC payment system comprises several essential components. First, the payment processor, such as NOWPayments, facilitates cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees. Next, content delivery solutions like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure that digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. Additionally, backend logic is handled by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, providing a reliable and efficient order management system. Together, these components create a robust infrastructure that supports digital sales without the constraints of traditional financial systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with a no-KYC payment gateway, first, choose a digital product you want to sell, such as an ebook or online course. Next, set up a payment processor like NOWPayments, ensuring you configure it for your cryptocurrency preferences. Use a platform like Cloudflare Pages for your website hosting, and automate your product delivery with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. By following these steps, you can quickly deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack and start accepting payments without the burdens of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a no-KYC payment gateway that accepts cryptocurrencies. This allows you to process payments directly and retain more of your profits. Platforms like NOWPayments provide a reliable solution that eliminates the restrictions of traditional payment gateways, making it easier for you to reach your customers globally.
Automate your digital product delivery for a seamless customer experience.

If you're looking to build your own sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit contains all the blueprints and templates you need to deploy a fully operational online store without relying on platforms like PayPal or Gumroad.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to set up your own website with a no-KYC payment processor. This allows you to keep more of your profits and avoid high transaction fees.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by utilizing a no-KYC payment gateway. This empowers you to retain full control over your sales and profits.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for digital sales?
You can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies using gateways like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 coins. This flexibility allows you to cater to different customer preferences.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, you can automate product delivery using tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that customers receive their digital products instantly after payment confirmation.
